method: Compile all Python fences and execute the scheduling and registry demos. Run synthetic mixed-order batches, verify per-call result matching and serialization, inject a peer timeout after simulated commit, ensure unknown outcomes halt for reconciliation, and exercise known error and validator cases.
limitations: Authorization is reviewed as architecture guidance; no identity provider, tenant database, authorization policy engine, or production permission boundary was exercised.
All tool calls are synthetic local functions; no provider, live model, external API, real side effect, cancellation, or distributed scheduler was tested.

The 2026-10-12 0.81 second latency remains a historical single-run measurement of sleep-based local functions; the approximately 1.2 second serial comparison is arithmetic, not a separately measured baseline.
Historical model response ratios in chapters 4 and 5 were not rerun; the prose now limits them to the original sample and setup.
